title: Pandemic and post-pandemic dynamics of respiratory viruses in a Spanish - Bioengineer.org

analysis.time: The fundamental premise rests on the fact that individuals infected with respiratory viruses shed viral genetic material not only through respiratory secretions but also, to varying degrees, through the gastrointestinal tract, which means that fragments of viral genomes routinely find their way into sewage systems.
analysis.event: Long-term wastewater surveillance of respiratory viruses.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: Captured infection dynamics, including seasonal resurgences of influenza and RSV, and provided early warnings for public health interventions.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: Continued collection through post-pandemic period, methodological consistency maintained, and results corroborated clinical trends.

analysis.brief_en: A study in a middle-size Spanish city used long-term wastewater surveillance to track respiratory viruses, capturing seasonal resurgences of influenza and RSV and providing early warnings for public health interventions. The research demonstrated the value of consistent methodological approaches in diverse urban settings, contributing to the growing body of literature on wastewater-based epidemiology.
analysis.summary_en: A study in a middle-size Spanish city used long-term wastewater surveillance to track respiratory viruses, capturing seasonal resurgences of influenza and RSV and providing early warnings for public health interventions.
